breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The agent correctly identified the conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the incorrect periodic condition, only specifying the Dirichlet conditions: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t) = 0 and u(1,t) = 0.'
